text.text_excerpt: Really loved this place. Only had drinks here but what a great vibe. Laid back, friendly, seemed like more of a place for locals than tourists although they get plenty of out of towners. This is going to be a regular stop for me. It's not pretentious or in your face Bourbon St style, it's just comfortable and decent. Good beer selection, great staff, pool tables and dartboards... This place is really well run. Prices are decent as well. Almost hoping that it stays a bit of a secret!
Great Dive bar. We've come two days in a row, they do great pours and their Irish cider is pretty good! You can shoot pool or play darts...

In New Orleans more than any other city, appearances are deceiving. This city is an old city with some buildings dating back to the early 1800's. What looks like an unappealing building may in fact be a refuge for one's soul. Fahy's is such a place. It is non-descript and unassuming from the exterior but once you venture inside it is a place where you will end up spending a few hours without even noticing the time. The walls and ceiling are decorated and have cool items such as trophies on the wall and posters on the ceiling. I also like the Christmas lights all over the bar.
